description: What the effect ids used by the document mean: for each its parameters and, where this profile defines it, its arithmetic with test vectors and the words that arithmetic is written with; and the formula of every blend mode.

blend_modes.description: Every blend mode, in the application's menu order.

formula.description: What the mode computes (profile document 6.9 gives the frame around it).

effects.description: One entry per effect id the document uses, in ascending id.

items.description: One effect id and what it means.

anyOf.description: The normative arithmetic of the effect, in the words of the catalog's `primitives` and of the section `section`; null when `rendering` is `parameters-only` or `none`.

definition.description: The normative arithmetic of the effect, in the words of the catalog's `primitives` and of the section `section`; null when `rendering` is `parameters-only` or `none`.

id.description: The effect id an effect instance names.

kind.description: What the effect acts on. `video`: it changes the layer's picture; `audio`: it changes the layer's sound; `control`: it draws nothing: its parameters exist to be read by expressions.

limits.description: Settings of the effect the definition does not cover (a reader that meets one treats the effect as `parameters-only`). Present with a definition; usually empty.

items.description: One thing the definition leaves undefined.
One parameter of an effect: a property of that `match` in an effect instance's group.

default.description: The parameter's default, as a property value `{t, v}` (schema `core.motion.layer`, definition `value`).

id.description: The parameter's id: the `match` of its property.

kind.description: The kind of the parameter's value (the `t` of its value). `scalar`: Scalar; `vec2`: Vec2; `vec3`: Vec3; `color`: Color; `bool`: Bool; `enum`: Enum; `path`: Path; `text`: Text; `layer`: Layer; `gradient`: Gradient; `string`: Str.

ui.description: How the parameter is presented, with its range and option list where it has them (schema `core.motion.layer`, definition `param_ui`).

rendering.description: Whether this profile defines the effect's arithmetic. `exact`: `definition` is the normative arithmetic, given completely: a faithful implementation matches the vectors within `tolerance`, which covers binary32 against binary64 rounding only; `tolerance`: `definition` is the normative arithmetic; the result is reproducible within `tolerance` only; `parameters-only`: this revision of the profile does not define what the effect computes: a reader shows the layer without it and says so; `none`: the effect computes nothing.

section.description: The key in the catalog's `sections` of the words this definition shares with others. Present with a definition.

test_vectors.description: Test vectors of the definition. Present with a definition.

items.description: A test vector of an effect's definition, made by the writing application's renderer (the catalog's `primitives`, E7): the input is built from a formula, not stored.

context.description: What differs from the stated context of the vectors: `time` (seconds), `seed`.

height.description: Height of the output picture, pixels.

input.description: The input picture, by the name of its formula. `patch-a`: PATCH A; `patch-b`: PATCH B.

origin.description: Where the effect-space origin is in the output picture, pixels: [0, 0] unless the effect padded.

output.description: The output picture: width * height * 4 integers round(value * 65536) in decimal, joined by commas, row by row, premultiplied r, g, b, a.

output_sha256.description: The sha256 of the ASCII bytes of `output`, in lowercase hexadecimal.

params.description: Parameter id to value, for the parameters that differ from their defaults: a number, an array of numbers (a colour r, g, b, a; a point in layer pixels), a boolean, a string, or `patch-b` for a layer parameter that reads the layer showing PATCH B.

width.description: Width of the output picture, pixels (the input is 16 x 12; an effect that pads returns more).

third_party.description: True: the effect is a plug-in that is not part of the writing application (profile document 6.14).

tolerance.description: The largest difference of an output value of a test vector a conformant implementation may have, in units of 1/65536. Present with a definition.

primitives.description: The words every definition of this catalog is written with: the pixel model, colour words, filters, hashes, the test patches and the vector format. Present when the catalog has a definition.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's schema. Always 1 in profile motion-comp/1; a reader refuses the node (node scope) when it is anything else.

sections.description: Section name to the words the definitions of that section share. Present when the catalog has a definition.

unknown.description: Effect ids the document uses that the writing application did not know (an effect instance another tool put there, or a plug-in that was not loaded): they are kept in the layers, and nothing is known about them here.

title: core.effect.catalog
